def to_xml(self, value: Any, version: str, nsmap: Dict[str, str], prettyprint: bool=True, indent: str='') -> Optional[str]:
    if value is None:
        return ''
    if not prettyprint:
        indent = ''
    if self.attribute:
        return f'{self.attribute}="{mod_utils.make_str(value)}"'
    elif self.type_converter:
